test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some bulbs are sands.

All bulbs are candles.

Conclusion:

(I) Some candles are bulbs.

(II) No candle is a sand.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14369472ab5c57fd612df6793e29b5bc2d485d756d672e2beb2af8f8ef4e6f5f.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some candles are bulbs → **F**ollow (As all bulbs are candles. As whole bulbs comes in candles, therefore it is false.)

(II) No candle is a sand → Does not follow (As some bulbs are sands and all bulbs are candles. As whole bulbs comes in candles and has some part common with sand, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
